notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Summer Game-Fiesta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/86e78c86c91048528e462fb4a376c7971f84a76d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/f7c3eb79e1661724e66c0254bbe68cc030f8ff1d.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow gamers![/h3]
[b]Before we all go full summer mode chilling out on the beach this is the time when we can enjoy the summertime-gaming-fiesta filled with releases, sales and new surprises straight from the Untold Tales world![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/392ee1f0d8546543f4f64db832bb689e5d9ce084.png[/img]
[h3]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following gaming goodies:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374230/Flame_Keeper

The moment you've all been waiting for is finally here! Flame Keeper is blazing out of early access and into full release with version 1.0! Get ready to ignite your gaming spirit as we introduce the Prophet, a wise villager who's seen more than a few winters and will guide you through the new Cloud biome, where you'll find icy islands that make winter wonderlands look like beach vacations. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/

Experience conveyor belt mayhem like never before, tackle the challenges of the factory floor, from operating and fixing malfunctioning machinery to navigating treacherous obstacles and prepare for the upcoming Let’s Party Update, which brings seven new minigames to the factory on June 28th.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/

The Wild West Map has just hit town, and it's a real humdinger! We're talking 5 diverse regions to explore, each with its unique flavor. From the dusty saloons to the treacherous oil fields, there's somethin' for everyone!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/be94a1e819b9e098761440ca12ca3a7a29d59f97.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

[h3]Channel your inner Gnome and get ready for EcoGnomix! [/h3]
Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes, combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna. The future of our gnomes is in your hands!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/cb333a10276e81714b48cf6c1e7fbaf5d0adfe12.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=VuIPqL-GCeU;full][/previewyoutube][h3]The sun-soaked shores of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/untoldtales/sale/untoldtales2024]Untold Tales Publisher Sale[/url] await you![/h3]
Explore diverse worlds, engage in captivating stories, and experience unforgettable gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42192/Untold_Tales_Treasures__30_for_30/
[h3]On top of that, we’ve launched the Untold Tales Treasures - a special gaming bundle filled with our titles, each designed with one ultimate goal: to deliver a unique gaming experience that will leave a lasting impression.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e6138e06f05a18fb75e4e89bfe8fbcde94ba4454.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/bff53bbb136d69eebfd0dcaf1119dc020882e85c.png[/img]
[h3]There never was a better chance to show off your balls to your friends![/h3]
Thanks to our collaboration with GimmeSwag we created the Ultimate Bang-On Balls: Chronicles plushie coming at you straight from the Roman Army. 
[b]Secure your Roman Army plushie today at [url=https://www.gimmeswag.com/products/bang-on-balls-plush?utm_source=In-Game&utm_medium=Pop+Up&utm_campaign=BoB+Roman+Army+Plush]GimmeSwag Store[/url]![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/b0d402a26a751b30d1566f5b349dec7304800e2c.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=l47gcVdtBAg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] 
[i][b]Greetings all you Tesla City Martians out there! [/b][/i]

Put on your headphones just like you would a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with all episodes of Radio Nostalgia Broadcast. 

[i]Dive into survivor stories blended with a harmonious tapestry of apocalypse-wave melodies.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/e255a95cc853e47c1cfbdd55de631d93bcab92ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44880844/5329ead788c53db121d72d8a24578400a336845c.png[/img]
We're almost halfway through the year and we've traveled a lot, not only virtually.
Be sure to follow our socials where we are going to share some cool spots we've already seen and give you some hints about the next stop for our Teddy on Tour.

See you on our socials 
[url=https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Twitter[/url]  / [url=https://www.instagram.com/untoldtaleshq/]Instagram[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtales.games]TikTok[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChrqRdrw-oNv-AXVMOwa1yw]YouTube[/url]

[b]Your continued support means the world to us![/b][i]
Previously on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/41232016/view/5923994639407330574?l=english]Untold Tales Presents[/url] [/i]

notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Blossom into Gaming Bliss
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/ff5c1af5dc7fe7570121d3c80d993df2fcb41e7a.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow adventurers![/h3]
[h3]Join us as we embrace the enchantment of this season, guided by the playful gaming sprite. Discover upcoming releases, essential must-haves, and timeless classics from Untold Tales, all tailored for your home entertainment. 
Let the joyous gaming journey bloom anew![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/df864d4d04cf4aa448996217a57ee2ca496e5e69.png[/img]
[b]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following titles:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/
[h3]Navigate a neon-lit apocalypse in a fusion of Jungle Book meets The Armageddon, brought to you by the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a hunted child, while catchy end-of-day tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551920/Tools_Up_Ultimate_Edition/
[h3]Dive into chaos-filled, local couch-coop extravaganza, all about renovating homes and the outdoors. It comes with all updates, content, and DLC in one package, supporting up to 4 players.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/3613a9f06b81f58ac9909d2037ffde00bd1b7844.png[/img]
[h3]And soon we will have a new task for you - lift the box and ensure its safe journey out of the factory. 
How difficult could it be, right? 
But the real test awaits amidst the conveyor belt chaos of Ready, Steady, Ship! 
Team up with a friend and prepare to step up the pace for the imminent release!

[b]Wishlist and Play the Demo now[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/32301091668e63686dd894417f7dfcf5636de657.png[/img]
[h3]The sun's shining, the birds are chirping, and the Steam Spring Sale 2024 is in full swing! It's the perfect time to cozy up indoors and lose yourself in some epic gaming adventures brought to you by Untold Tales.[/h3]

[b][h3][url=https://bit.ly/UT_SpringSale] CHECK OUR BLOOMING GAMING DEALS NOW[/url][/h3][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/731b461d83967476b1a22c9571c199a26a676e51.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/
[h3]Bang-On Balls: Chronicles is now available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S! Unlock the full potential of the next-gen consoles, making your escapades smoother and more visually stunning than ever before! This update is completely free for anyone who already owns Bang-On Balls: Chronicles on PS4 or Xbox One[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403650/Everdream_Valley/
[h3]Dream Bigger Together update brings up to 4-player coop to Everdream Valley. Do everything you can solo but together from exploring, building, caring for animals, or just seeking out your next adventure.[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777290/Boti_Byteland_Overclocked__Bitosaurus_DLC/
[h3]Jump in, transform into a fearsome Bitosaurus, and roar your way through Byteland![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/8148f0de522ffe890fef4ee7c459dd244be1376d.png[/img]
[h3]We encourage you to put on your headphones just like you would put on a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with Radio Nostalgia from Mars broadcasts:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Lvataz4WuvU;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/5646cc8398bafe936085cc7e326f32cc10ec5329.png[/img]
[h3]Thank you for embarking on this brief adventure with us, and we look forward to having you accompany us on future journeys. As we anticipate and prepare for upcoming exciting news, stay connected with us on our social media platforms:[/h3]

[h3][url=https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Twitter[/url]  / [url=https://www.instagram.com/untoldtaleshq/]Instagram[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtales.games]TikTok[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChrqRdrw-oNv-AXVMOwa1yw]YouTube[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]Patch notes: Update 1.0.2[/h2]

Fixed issues with the secondary objective (intercept convoy) in the Alternative history campaign 2nd operation:
[list]
[*]  If you were to lose even 1 transport ship the remaining ones did not land the units (reward). Now you get a Core unit for every ship that reaches the allied Seaport successfully.  (2 Matilda tanks and 1 Hurricane fighter)
[*]  If you eliminated Destroyers before capturing any Seaport, the ships would stop, and then they would not start moving to the Seaport you control when you capture one. Now, they start moving towards allied seaports.
[/list]

tags.bug: If you were to lose even 1 transport ship the remaining ones did not land the units (reward). Now you get a Core unit for every ship that reaches the allied Seaport successfully. (2 Matilda tanks and 1 Hurricane fighter)

If you eliminated Destroyers before capturing any Seaport, the ships would stop, and then they would not start moving to the Seaport you control when you capture one. Now, they start moving towards allied seaports.

notes.title: Headquarters: World War II, Dev Q&A, and Other News
notes.content:
General!

We have updated all the Strategic Mind series titles recently, with various minor issues being fixed, and with Strategic Mind: The Pacific getting a full Korean text localization. We plan to add more improvements and fixes closer to the Strategic Mind: Spirit of Liberty release next year.

[h1]Headquarters: World War II - our new project in partnership with Slitherine[/h1]

Headquarters: World War II is our first project with a publisher, and not just any publisher, but the number one publisher for niche strategy games - Slitherine. We are very happy with how the cooperation is going so far and we think that this project has everything it needs to become a very interesting and fun game for you guys to play.

Watch live announcement during the Home of Wargamers Live event:

[previewyoutube=WIaGkFdM6n0;full][/previewyoutube]
More information about Headquarters: World War II here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1381850/view/3141821682386771299
[h1]Watch the video Q&A with developers[/h1]

Our Lead game designer Oleksandr recorded a Q&A video and answered all of the questions we received. Here are some of them:
- Will you continue adding games to the SM franchise? Are you planning a SM2 with upgraded graphics and mechanics in the feature?
- Do you have a release date for spirit of liberty?
- When the Strategic Mind project ends with the last battlefield in Finland, what kind of project do you have in mind? Thinking of a new strategy game other than WWII?

[previewyoutube=5o6l50Cush0;full][/previewyoutube]
If you want your questions answered in the next Q&A session that will be held in February 2022 - feel free to follow the link below and ask us everything you want to know about our games and team:
https://forms.gle/sXq4vh1FNqkgyGFN6

[h1]Saturday screenshots from community #18[/h1]

This week we got new awesome community-made screenshots from the Strategic Mind series! Check them out and consider sharing your own playthrough with the community.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1381850/view/3141820505017496046

[h1]Winter Is Coming as General Night Phoenix attempts to conquer Moscow before winter![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31809087/53ca85377c9dba8bc3c4c8f1e578cb40eb1436eb.png[/img]

Night Phoenix faces arguably the largest and longest land operation in the entire series - the Battle of Moscow (German side):

Part 1: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fWc1xlGZUzc
Part 2: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gZUgvKXHsx8

We hope you like this epic battle being played on Challenging difficulty. 

Consider wishlisting and following our new project Headquarters: World War II to keep an eye on it:
